perField.identityName: Look for a pattern: a^2−b^2 (difference of squares), (a+b)^2 (square of a sum), a^3−b^3 (difference of cubes), or a^3+b^3 (sum of cubes).
perField.flashcardAnswer:
Key identities to memorize:
• Diff of Squares: a²−b²=(a+b)(a−b)
• Square of Sum: (a+b)²=a²+2ab+b²
• Square of Diff: (a−b)²=a²−2ab+b²
• Sum of Cubes: a³+b³=(a+b)(a²−ab+b²)
• Diff of Cubes: a³−b³=(a−b)(a²+ab+b²)
Tip: In cubes, the middle sign is OPPOSITE the original sign!
perField.rewriteChoice:
Match to the identity:
• a^2−b^2=(a+b)(a−b)
• (a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2
• a^3±b^3=(a±b)(a^2∓ab+b^2)
Watch the sign on the middle term for cubes!
perField.numericResult:
Try rewriting first:
• (n+d)(n−d)=n^2−d^2
• (a±b)^2=a^2±2ab+b^2
• a^3±b^3=(a±b)(a^2∓ab+b^2)
Then compute.
perField.factorAnswer:
Step 1: Identify a and b so the expression matches a^2−b^2, a^3−b^3, or a^3+b^3.
Step 2: Apply the identity.
Tip: Use parentheses for factors and ^ for exponents.
perField.pascalValue:
For Pascal’s Triangle: each interior number is the sum of the two numbers diagonally above it.
Row sums follow 1,2,4,8,... so the sum of Row n is 2^n.
Binomial coefficients C(n,k) are the numbers in Row n.
perField.pascalExplain: Sentence frame: “I used Pascal’s Triangle. [Explain adjacent sums / row sum 2^n / row n gives C(n,k)]. The coefficient I needed is ______ because ______.”
perField.termCoeff: For the term that uses k copies of the second term: coefficient = C(n,k)·(p)^(n−k)·(q)^k. The exponents are {{var1}}^(n−k) and {{var2}}^k.
perField.termExpVar1: The exponents always add to n. Starting term has {{var1}}^n, then {{var1}} exponent decreases by 1 each term.
perField.termExpVar2: The exponent of {{var2}} increases by 1 each term (starting at 0).
perField.errorExplain: Common mistake: using only p^(n−k)q^k and forgetting the binomial coefficient C(n,k) (from Pascal’s Triangle). Also check the exponent pattern: powers add to n.
